hypothesis: Can the full Native factual-memory backbone learn an independent B-history-dependent sign reversal of the intervention effect that a frozen selected-fifth-only causal binder cannot infer, outperform a genuinely trained matched-sample history-only recurrent control, and lose that gain when the Native backbone or B information is ablated?

source.generator: new author-generated source-neutral causal task independent FIT, DEV, OOD group/B seeds; original R38 binder replay only as frozen pretrained component
source.fifth_physics: existing R32 quartic or R38 amended cubic with q=sign*q_abs; h is NOT allowed to alter any observation before or including the selected fifth probe
source.return_physics: only on the return selected action: same law with q_effective=q*history_gate; history_gate independently ±1
source.hidden_gate: independent history_gate ±1 balanced within each public context and fifth sign; public B observation includes selected physical measurement +.27*gate with tiny deterministic nuisance at one B event
source.B_noise: independent bounded nuisance amplitude <= .024, no hidden sign or gate in other B records
source.fifth_observed_action: always equals public context; sign q learnable from actual selected fifth consequence, never q injected into model
source.return_action: factual separately selected return 0 and 1 episodes with same past observations; labels by actually selected return only

models.binder_pretrain_source: R39 exact original R38 AdamW 512 steps and FIT info-seed 21249999; verify original decision fingerprints, freeze weights on R41
models.backbones: original R34 FactualMemory native_factual_memory / history_only / gru_factual_memory / ssm_factual_memory; same frozen binder additive scalar readout, no analytic history gate or hand-coded B marker feature
models.information: every trained arm receives the same P80 full factual action/effect history, selected fifth physical measurement, and candidate return key; no evaluator sign/gate
models.binder_only_baseline: exact frozen R38 binder no B input, score only
models.conventional_positive_control: FIT-only fitted factual measurement baselines and a public hand-coded gate × fifth sign diagnostic, no training on DEV/OOD; keep separate from neural native claim
negative_controls: erase B marker effect after selection
swap B marker effects within sign/context-matched gate-opposite worlds

training.loss: cross entropy of two separately selected FIT factual return-cost labels; no hidden labels
